The **Electro Enforcer** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Invaders from Beyond* update.

A blunt weapon of Alien origin, swung with both hands. It can be repaired with one of each Adhesive, Circuitry, Crystal and two Plastic.
